name: Hanamiya Nagisa
source:
A senior member of the astronomy club, Nagisa is undoubtedly the most dangerous person in the entire school. She’s from a very powerful family and Nagisa herself is not one to be trifled with, not to mention she has an air of mysteriousness surrounding her. She is a genius girl but the lonely type. Enjoys bullying [url=/c477]Sou[/url] just for the fun of it.
